content.comment_body: This error can have multiple causes. If you are using an international SIM card, make sure to enter the phone number in the format +49 instead of 0049 in the 'Users / Groups' section on the [product_name] communication module.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced an issue where incoming SMS messages were not processed by the [product_name] communication module. It was determined that an incorrect phone number format in the configuration, specifically using +49 rather than 0049 with international SIM cards, can cause this problem. This highlights the importance of proper input formatting in device configuration for correct operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] communication module to consistently receive and handle incoming SMS messages regardless of how the phone number is formatted, or at least to provide clear guidance about required formatting.
